text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with Sakura Laurel,
we decided to enter the Hanshin Daishoten
before heading to the Tenno Sho (Spring).
And while traveling to the Kansai region—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... The bullet train tickets, both Green Cars and reserved seats are totally wiped out... Every single time slot is booked full...

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
D~u~de~, haven't you checked Umatter?
The unreserved seats today are pure hell, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text: Of course everyone's going to go watch the Hanshin Daishoten since Narita Brian is running in it~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...
You're insanely popular, Brian-chan."
choice_data_list: Maybe she was the "long-awaited hero" after all, huh
Maybe she was the "long-awaited hero" after all

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A hero, you say?

In the world of racing,
"heroes" emerge time and time again.

"Strength, star power, and a passion that makes people want to cheer.
Among all the different ideals of a hero,
what Narita Brian showed us was—"
—An unwavering strength.

Just how many Umamusume throughout history
have truly been worthy of being engraved as 'the strongest'?

Legends are born only in fleeting moments.
Therefore, the witnesses who see them are few.
choice_data_list: (That's why everyone wants to be a witness.)

text_block_list.text:
"Rather than learning about her 'after the fact'
as a figure of the past, I want to witness
the 'present' in which she lives."
That Umamusume I know is the one who—
—That she is the one and only "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan was the perfect fit for the title
of "Strongest Umamusume" that everyone had been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Umamusume are making their appearance in the Hanshin Daishoten paddock!
Naturally—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—And so does this Umamusume,
the 'Monster,' Narita Brian!!"
(Woooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... *huff*, *puff*...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Brian's intensity insane today...?
It's like steam's practically rising off her before she even runs...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she has a presence unlike anything before!!
She's definitely going to make history today...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(The instant they appeared,
everyone's expressions changed.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed,
she is truly a "hero."
